description: A photograph displaying the canopy of a broadleaved forest during autumn. The trees exhibit a range of seasonal foliage colours, including shades of dark green, golden yellow, bright orange, and deep red. Above the tree line, a dark, cloudy sky is visible, with a band of lighter sky near the horizon. This visual represents a natural or semi-natural broadleaved forest, consistent with EUNIS classes G1.6 to G1.B, which comprise species like _Fagus_, _Quercus_, _Carpinus orientalis_, _Castanea sativa_, _Ostrya carpinifolia_, _Betula_, _Populus tremula_, _Sorbus aucuparia_, _Ulmus_ spp., _Fraxinus excelsior_, _Tilia cordata_, and _Acer platanoides_.
